The first revelation

Surah Al-Alaq — the first words revealed

۞

اقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ ﴿١﴾ خَلَقَ الْإِنسَانَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ ﴿٢﴾ اقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ الْأَكْرَمُ ﴿٣﴾ الَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِالْقَلَمِ ﴿٤﴾ عَلَّمَ الْإِنسَانَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ ﴿٥﴾

“Read, in the name of your Lord who created — created man from a clinging clot. Read, and your Lord is the Most Generous — who taught by the pen — taught man what he did not know.”

Surah Al-Alaq · Chapter 96 · Verses 1–5

Online Quran classes for kids

A gentle, safe and engaging way for children

Children learn best when they feel safe and praised. Every kids' class is built around patience, encouragement and a pace the child sets.

  • A gentle pace for ages 4–15Short, focused lessons that hold a child's attention — never rushed, never pressured.
  • Parents may join any classSit in whenever you like, and see exactly how your child is taught and progressing.
  • A report you can read every monthA clear written report after each month — lessons covered, memorisation, and next goals.

Quran classes for adults & beginners

A calm space for adults and new learners

Starting late, returning after years away, or beginning from the very first letter — you are welcome here, exactly as you are.

  • Begin from zero, without embarrassmentStart with the alphabet and Noorani Qaida, step by step. No question is too basic.
  • Times that fit work and familyEarly morning, evening or weekend slots — arranged around your local time zone.
  • Recitation corrected with respectTajweed fixed gently in every lesson, until reading the Quran feels natural and confident.

Our courses

A clear path from the first letter to fluent, beautiful recitation — every course taught live, one to one.

نورانی قاعدہ

Noorani Qaida

The foundation course: Arabic letters, correct pronunciation (Makharij) and joining words — the right start for children and adult beginners.

BeginnersAges 4+
ناظرہ قرآن

Nazra Quran

Learn to read the Holy Quran correctly and fluently, page by page, with every mistake spotted and fixed in the lesson itself.

Reading fluencyAll ages

Questions

Frequently asked questions

Anything else on your mind? Ask us on WhatsApp — we reply personally.

Send one WhatsApp message and we fix a short live call at a time that suits you. The teacher listens to the student's recitation, checks the level, and recommends the right course and package. It is completely free — no card and no obligation to continue.

Just a phone, tablet or laptop with an internet connection. Classes are held live on a video call, one to one. For young children, a parent sitting nearby for the first few classes is helpful but not required.

Yes. Timings are arranged around your local time zone — the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, the Gulf or anywhere else — and around school, work and family routines. Need to reschedule a class? One WhatsApp message is enough.

Every month you receive a written progress report covering what was taught, what improved, and the goals for the next month. Parents are also welcome to sit in on any class, any time — the door is always open.

Not at all — many of our students are adults starting from the very first letter of Noorani Qaida. You will be taught privately, at your own pace, without any embarrassment. No question is ever too basic.

After your free assessment, we share the simple payment options for your country on WhatsApp before you commit to anything. Fees are monthly, there is no registration fee, and you can pause or stop at the end of any month.
